cacheArchitecture.stableCrossTickCache: A simulation-owned bounded cache for exact settlement-anchor and central-depot origins only. Current balanced_basin collapses these Godot-exact-equal origins to one entry; the hard capacity is two entries.
cacheArchitecture.ephemeralPerTickCache: Keep the current per-tick cache semantics for all other origins, including moving citizen positions; clear these entries at each Advance exactly as today.
cacheArchitecture.fieldImmutability: PrototypeNavigationGrid.GeometricDistanceField is immutable after construction and owns its exact grid reference, exact origin, origin cell index, and grid-sized float distance array.
cacheArchitecture.destinationDomain: Destination eligibility is not a field-key input because the field covers every walkable destination cell in the current grid. Eligible destination sets only decide whether ShouldBuildGeometricDistanceField reaches the construction threshold.
cacheArchitecture.referenceMode: An internal, non-persistent opt-in mode retains the current per-tick rebuild behavior for direct differential tests. Metrics-off/default runtime uses stable-cache reuse.

exactCacheKeyContract.navigationGridInstanceIdentity: Reference identity of the exact current PrototypeNavigationGrid. This composite identity owns the world-map instance, grid cells, neighbor topology, world positions, accessibility mask, built-path flags, and traversal multipliers.
exactCacheKeyContract.navigationRulesVersion: Exact _navigationRulesVersion and PrototypeNavigationGrid.RulesVersion; mismatch is a miss and invalidates the entry.
exactCacheKeyContract.gridShape: Exact GridWidth, GridHeight, cell count, and bit-exact cell-size value from the current WorldMapState.
exactCacheKeyContract.origin: Godot's existing exact Vector3 equality semantics plus resolved origin grid X/Y identity. Approximate equality, including IsEqualApprox-style matching, is explicitly forbidden; same-cell origins that are not exactly equal remain distinct.
exactCacheKeyContract.accessibilityAndTopology: Bound to current grid instance and rules version, which encapsulate wetland exclusion, slope <= 18 degrees, diagonal corner-cut rejection, cell world positions, and neighbor topology.
exactCacheKeyContract.movementAndBuiltPathCosts: Geometric field arithmetic uses geometric neighbor distances, not movement-cost or built-path traversal multipliers. Nevertheless any current or future movement/rules/cost version change must conservatively rebuild navigation and invalidate stable fields before reuse.
exactCacheKeyContract.lookupValidation: A cache hit requires ReferenceEquals(entry.Grid, _navigationGrid), matching rules version, Godot exact Vector3 origin equality, and matching resolved origin-cell identity. Approximate Vector3 equality is never accepted. Any mismatch removes or bypasses the entry and rebuilds.

authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.construct: Build only after the existing ShouldBuildGeometricDistanceField threshold passes; never eagerly prefill.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.reuse: Reuse only stable-origin entries whose complete key and entry validation match. A hit performs no field allocation and no field rebuild.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.advance: Clear only ephemeral arbitrary-origin entries per tick; preserve valid stable entries in optimized/default mode. Reference mode clears both.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.rebuildNavigation: Clear both stable and ephemeral field caches before replacing _navigationGrid, whether the rebuild is initial, restoration-driven, or rule-change-driven.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.invalidateNavigation: Increment rules version, clear all field caches through RebuildNavigation, and prove the first post-change lookup uses the new grid/version.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.loadStateAndRestore: LoadState must end with empty derived caches bound to the newly rebuilt grid. ApplySnapshot publishes only the candidate simulation after its rebuild succeeds.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.scenarioResetAndInitialize: New PrototypeSettlementSimulation construction starts with empty caches; GameManager scenario switches and PrototypeRuntimeSession.Initialize cannot carry entries across worlds.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.performanceCacheClear: ClearDerivedPathCacheForPerformance must clear stable and ephemeral geometric fields as well as _pathCache so cold/forced-invalidation evidence cannot inherit a warm lower-bound field.
authoritativeLifecycleAndInvalidation.futureRuleOrCostMutation: Any new walkability, neighbor topology, cell world-position, grid size/cell size, movement/accessibility, or geometric-distance rule mutation must route through navigation rebuild and full field-cache invalidation before becoming authoritative.

memoryAndConcurrency.eviction: No unbounded LRU. At most two stable keys exist; on an unexpected third stable key or key replacement, clear stale/non-current entries first and deterministically replace only the matching named stable-origin slot.
memoryAndConcurrency.ephemeralBound: Arbitrary origins remain bounded to one tick and are cleared at Advance; no moving citizen origin may enter the cross-tick cache.
memoryAndConcurrency.estimatedEntryPayload: One float per grid cell plus the existing immutable field object and key; maximum persistent payload is two fields for the current grid.
memoryAndConcurrency.threadAssumption: PrototypeSettlementSimulation Advance and all cache mutation are single-thread owned. No lock is added. Parallel simulation access is unsupported; introducing it requires a new review and synchronization contract.
memoryAndConcurrency.persistence: Derived field entries, cache keys, private/internal counters, and reference mode are never serialized, hashed into gameplay state, exported in public snapshots, or restored from disk.
memoryAndConcurrency.counterVisibility: Stable-cache hit, build, and clear counters remain private/internal and are read only through internal managed probes/tests. They are absent from persistence, public output, runtime CSV, performance/equivalence JSON, run summaries, world summaries, validation manifests, and generated artifacts.
memoryAndConcurrency.publicSurface: No public API, startup, CLI, GameManager, persistence, schema, or artifact contract gains a behavior selector.
